# PDF-YZ — Free Online PDF Editor

> PDF-YZ is a free, browser-based PDF editor by Zigmoon. Edit text, replace images, annotate, sign, crop, do print imposition (4/8/16-up) and re-export — 100% locally in the browser, no upload, no account, no tracking. Installable as a PWA.

## Why PDF-YZ matters
- **Privacy by design**: Files are never uploaded. All processing runs client-side via WebAssembly (pdf-lib + pdf.js).
- **Free, no account, no watermark**.
- **Works offline** once installed (PWA with service worker).
- **Genuine text editing**: extracted text blocks are masked and re-rendered with the user's font, size and color, not just overlaid.

## Core features
- Edit existing PDF text inline (font picker incl. Google Fonts, size, color, bold/italic, alignment).
- Replace embedded images.
- Annotate: highlight, freehand draw, sticky notes, eraser.
- Digital signature capture (canvas-based).
- Page management: add, delete, reorder, crop (per-page or all pages).
- Print imposition: 2/4/8/16 pages per sheet with crop marks and bleed.
- Find & replace.
- Find images and replace them.
- ICC color profile selection.
- Export with PDF/A standard, custom DPI, custom page size.
- Print directly from the browser.

## Keyboard shortcuts
- `Ctrl+S` Export · `Ctrl+P` Print · `Ctrl+F` Find · `Ctrl+O` Open · `Ctrl+Shift+N` New blank
- `Ctrl+Z` Undo · `Ctrl+Y` / `Ctrl+Shift+Z` Redo · `Ctrl+D` Duplicate selected
- `Ctrl+B` Toggle Pages sidebar
- `Ctrl + + / − / 0 / 1` Zoom in / out / 100% / fit
- `Page Up / Page Down / Home / End` Page navigation
- `Arrows` (Shift = 10 px) Nudge selection · `Del / Backspace` Delete selection
- `V T I D H E` Tools (select/text/image/draw/highlight/eraser)
- `?` or `F1` Help · `Esc` Close panels / deselect

## Tech stack
- Rust core compiled to WebAssembly (geometry, colour, imposition, session arithmetic),
  Astro interface, Tauri desktop shell.
- pdf-lib 1.17.1 (modify) + pdf.js 4.9.155 (render), both served from the same
  origin — no CDN, so the app works with the network off.
- PWA: `manifest.webmanifest`, `service-worker.js`, file_handler for `application/pdf`, share_target POST.
- Storage: `localStorage` for prefs + IndexedDB (`pdfyz-sessions`) for the per-document sessions, 7-day TTL, 10 MB cap per file.
